scope: Actual supplied donor FBX rendered appearance and suitability as revision base. No final rig/export/Unreal acceptance.
method: Directly opened four original actual render PNGs and seven canonical actual render PNGs, and read actual inventory. The first view labels follow unnormalized input axes; canonical views provide corrected semantic camera names. Reviewer made no Blender/UE/model changes.

additional_actual_texture_inspection.observation: The actual embedded 2048x2048 color atlas visibly contains dark chestnut/russet leather/hair, olive cloth, warm ivory and skin/eye details. Pale studio render alone is not evidence that the atlas palette is absent or should be globally darkened.
additional_actual_texture_inspection.display_limit: Viewer downscaled to 1600x1600; this review establishes broad palette/content, not per-texel detail or UV sampling fidelity.

axes: Original donor front is +X and T-pose arm span follows Y; original right.png is front, left.png is rear, front.png/back.png are opposite profiles. Canonical camera front.png is actual front.

numeric_findings_from_inventory_not_visu.height_and_origin: Not yet normalized to existing 1.7m ground-level Arin contract.

requirements.requirement: Face and hair visibly closer to reference than v2
requirements.observation: Large almond eyes, dark upper eye region, friendly mouth, shaped cheeks/chin, side part, swept locks, temple curl and full braid correspond closely to the supplied image. The profiles have an actual shaped ear/neck/nose and hair-root volume. These are substantially stronger reference matches than the small-eye/cap-hair v2.
requirements.limit: Texture contributes much of the eye/lip appearance; separated eyeballs, eyelid geometry and facial controls are not established by this review.

requirements.requirement: Hood/cape drape, cloth folds and embroidery preserve reference identity
requirements.observation: Actual rear hood exists; rounded shoulder cape wraps the shoulder with front overlap, cloth-fold volume and a continuous leaf border. Sleeves, waist, coat/apron hem and rear coat have fabric folds and layered silhouette, without the v2 flat triangular mantle and bare rectangular coat panels.
requirements.limit: The T-pose preserves a broad cape under the arms; its arms-down and reach deformation has not been demonstrated.

requirements.requirement: Body, trouser and footwear silhouette materially improves the reference match
requirements.observation: Donor has fuller thigh/calf cloth allowance, visible knee/ankle folds, broad boot cuffs, shaped heels/toes, wrapped straps and panel stitching. Side and rear silhouette remain coherent and much closer to the reference than thin smooth v2 trousers and boots.

Satchel has a broad rounded flap and stitched shape, belt and strap have detail, potion holsters and bracers are much less primitive than v2. Donor bag still differs from the reference's exact two-strap arrangement; preserving coherent existing donor detail is preferable to replacing it with v2's smooth pouch.

requirements.requirement: Reference palette and material depth under the current actual render
requirements.observation: Current donor render is pale and desaturated relative to the reference. Hair looks light taupe/pink and the leather lacks the dark chestnut/russet depth; cape is light gray-olive. The embedded color texture supplies visible details, but no roughness/metallic/normal texture system is demonstrated.
requirements.repair: Actual source atlas already contains the desired dark/olive/warm colors. First verify sRGB BaseColor, neutral emission/albedo, lighting and material response. Preserve original color detail; only make evidence-backed local color correction after that diagnosis. Author appropriate material-response maps without global atlas darkening.

requirements.requirement: Local hair/bracer continuity free of dark triangular defects
requirements.observation: The face render contains a small black triangular discontinuity at the crown/part around pixel (370,244) in the 800x900 image. The hand view contains a black triangular discontinuity under a bracer seam around (122,378). Inventory reports open/non-manifold geometry, but these specific marks may be geometry openings, intersecting dark faces or baked texture shadow; pixels alone do not establish the cause.
requirements.repair: Inspect those local source faces/UVs and adjacent normals before repair. Close only confirmed unwanted seams/holes while preserving curls, intended garment openings and existing UVs. Reopen the same camera views after final export.

requirements.requirement: Hand anatomy and per-finger continuity ready for a closeup game character
requirements.observation: Donor has softer taper and a better thumb/palm shape than v2. The visible hand still has simplified rounded fused roots and the supplied reference is front-oriented. Opposite hand, palm-side, finger topology and articulation have not been inspected in enough views to call a complete anatomical/rig pass.

requirements.requirement: Preserve existing functional Unreal Arin rig and animation
requirements.observation: The original donor is static: no armature, actions or skin weights. Reusing its visible surface alone does not preserve the working tutorial NPC's Idle. Binding, scale/origin normalization, safe export and actual engine validation remain required.
requirements.repair: Root should preserve the current functionality contract, bind the donor surface or its retopologized version to the chosen compatible rig, and verify arm-down, reach, elbow, both knees, twist and Idle.

requirements.requirement: Game budget and lower LOD preserve critical forms
requirements.observation: 90,186 triangles is above the previous procedural-v2 51,634, but no revised task budget or target gameplay performance has been measured. It is not an automatic quality defect. Face/hair/hand detail is vulnerable to indiscriminate reduction.
requirements.repair: Preserve high-quality authored donor source and select an explicit export/LOD budget. Prefer region-aware reduction and inspect face/hair/cape/hand silhouette at every LOD; do not infer triangle counts from vertex ratios or claim performance from a polycount alone.

source_inspector_followup.crown_mark: Inspector reports actual small crown/part gap as 7-edge closed boundary loop at approximately normalized x=-0.009,y=-0.12,z=1.623. This is source inspection evidence supplied by that agent, not geometry inspection performed by this art reviewer.
source_inspector_followup.bracer_mark: Inspector reports an actual small black bracer hole; root/inspector should retain the location/topology report before source repair.
source_inspector_followup.eyes: Inspector reports eyes as textured surface, without separate eye geometry or facial rig.

critical_recheck: Neutral albedo/color-space review before palette correction
Hair part and bracer dark triangle source cause
Cape/braid/bag/coat motion under arms-down, reach, twist and bilateral knee bend
Actual Unreal material, LOD and existing tutorial NPC behavior
